title: Qualify TS-RESPONSIVE-017 line-breaking sentence for the item cell's 14rem basis
todo:
**Problem:** In `doc/specifications/responsive-layout/technical.md` line 117 (TS-RESPONSIVE-017), "Flex line breaking puts each cell on the current line when its max-content width fits" is not exact for the item cell: `src/index.css` sets `.responsive-table tbody tr td:has(> .item-cell) { flex: 1 1 14rem }`, so line breaking uses its 14rem flex base size, not its max-content width.

**Suggested work:** Qualify the sentence, for example "Flex line breaking puts each cell (the item cell from its 14rem basis) on the current line when its width fits, and otherwise starts a new line.", so the paragraph has no other mismatch with TS-RESPONSIVE-023. Documentation only; no CSS change.
